thread:
incident-bot: [PAGER] P1 - Significant increase in 5xx and upstream timeouts for /v1/complete across edge gateways in APAC. Alert: edge-5xx-spike, 5m agg -> 9.4% (normal ~0.2%). Paging Liam (oncall) and infra-sre. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/lb-envoy-5xx

Liam (oncall): I'll take it. Infra-sre, Nora, Priya @ here. Spinning up a conference and attaching links.

infra-sre: joining. Early look: retries and per_try_timeout events in envoy clusters for "complete-service-canary". Backend app pods show healthy liveness but high connection resets.

Nora: digging into envoy stats: cluster.complete-service-canary.upstream_rq_5xx: spike, upstream_rq_timeout increased, upstream_cx_overflow logged. Example: envoys hitting 503 from upstream and then returning 502 to clients.

Priya: we rolled a route update 30m ago to shift 30% traffic to a new canary with an experimental circuit_breakers template. That template may have low limits. I can revert weight if we want immediate mitigation.

Carlos (support): customer impact: chat logs show large retailers experiencing aborted responses. We've paused outbound notifications but customers are seeing timeouts. Need ETA for fix to inform them.

Liam (oncall): mitigation plan: A) remove retry_on for route to avoid amplification B) shift weight back to stable pool C) raise canary circuit breaker thresholds D) short-term route-level rate-limit to protect canary. Any objections?

infra-sre: no objections. Applying A now — disabling retries on /v1/complete route. Using control-plane patch (snippet):

```bash
# patch route in consul/gitops
kubectl -n control-plane exec deploy/envoy-config -- curl -X PATCH http://127.0.0.1:9901/config_dump -d @/tmp/no-retries.json
# or update gitops and apply
```

infra-sre: pushed config, broadcasting to edge envoys. Watching metrics.

DevRelBot: Deploy webhook: env-config-update triggered by infra-sre at 2026-03-14T21:02Z. CI checks passed.

Nora: metrics: 3m after disabling retries -> 5xx rate down from 9.4% to 3.0%, upstream_rq_timeout still visible but decreasing. Still seeing some 504s at ingress.

Priya: shifting weight back to stable pool now (helm set routes.complete.weight=100).

infra-sre: helm change applied. Also bumping canary cluster circuit_breakers thresholds to safer defaults (max_requests: 1000, max_pending_requests: 100).

```yaml
# gitops diff snippet
clusters:
- name: complete-service-canary
  circuit_breakers:
    thresholds:
    - max_connections: 2000
      max_pending_requests: 100  # previously 0
      max_requests: 1000         # previously 20
```

Priya: the canary had max_pending_requests: 0 and max_requests: 20 which made it brittle under bursts. That explains immediate rejections and retry amplification.

Carlos (support): post-mitigation update: ticket volume dropped by ~80% after changes. Still some customers reported partial failures for ~15 minutes. Notifying impacted account leads now.

Liam (oncall): good. Next steps: keep canary out of rotation until a full audit of circuit breaker templates is completed. Create postmortem ticket and update runbook to add an automated check for non-zero max_pending_requests on canary templates.

infra-sre: created ticket INC-7921 (postmortem + config audit) and added owners. Also suppressed the noisy alert for 1h to prevent alert storm while we stabilize.

Nora: storing logs and sample traces in incident doc. Adding envoy stat dumps and gitops diffs to the ticket.

Priya: action item: add gate to rollout pipeline to validate CB thresholds against traffic profile, and add canary smoke tests for tail latency.

Liam (oncall): handoff: I'll monitor for the next 20m then hand to Priya for follow-up and postmortem. Carlos will keep customers updated.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated (SEV-3). Please file a postmortem within 72h. Timeline: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2766000000

Liam (oncall): thanks team. Document any remaining artifacts in the PM ticket. Closing thread here. :thumbsup:
